lyrics: yeah…
Mainu lagda Mirror vi hai jealous
you know what happens when I walk in, right?
Main vibe da mood-setter,
Room ‘ch enter karaan — weather better.
Lok kehnde “who’s that man?”
Bas keh de — that’s the brand man.
Main vibe da trademark,
Tu bas scroll kare remark.
Main headline, tu bas ik highlight,
Main light jide chakkde spotlight.
Mirror vich vi main flex karaan,
Apne reflection nu stress karaan.
Ni main glitch in the plan,
Main trend jide haan fans.
Main walk karaan slow-mo, beat kare mainu follow,
Crowd vich shor jad vekhe mainu solo.
Tere jiven looks, broke protocol,
Tu danger zone, main control wall.
Phone vich mera naam bold letters,
Main classy, never off-center.
Main talk karaan smooth — jiven vinyl jaan wool,
Style mera final, kise chahidi na trial.
Ni I’m too hot to handle, ho jaave na koi scandal,
Main taan move karaan candle, tu fire di ik angle.
Tere nazran ne keeta scramble,
Ni tu smile kare, main lose heart da pah-nel.
Ni I’m too hot to handle,
Playlist ‘te tera channel,
Eyes on me, tu ik angle,
Heart went pop — oops! it’s a scandal!
Mainu pata main show-stopper,
Main spark, baaki dropper.
Je main aa jaavaan scene ‘ch,
Timing hi ban jaave proper.
Mirror mera best friend ae,
Camera mera yes man ae.
Main idhar hoon for a reason —
Tu bas reh fan mera poora season.
Ni I’m too hot to handle…
Ho jaave na koi scandal…
Main taan move karaan candle, tu fire di ik angle,
Heart went pop — oops! it’s a scandal!
too hot… no scandal 🔥
Mirror vich vi main flex karaan…
reflection stress karaan 💋
